idea-plugin.name: JFrog for Coding Agents
idea-plugin.description:
Official JFrog plugin for JetBrains IDEs.

Delivers the JFrog Platform Agent Skills bundle and a JFrog (remote) MCP server to Junie on IDE startup - discovered by convention from ~/.junie/skills/ and ~/.junie/mcp/mcp.json.
